problem_statement: Ensure responses that refresh a permanent session cookie include Vary: Cookie while preserving ordinary requests, session reads and disabled-refresh behavior.
notes: The reference patch is the upstream implementation change under BSD-3-Clause in LICENSE.upstream.
The original MIT-licensed evaluation oracle uses Flask test clients and a public evaluation-only signing string; no service is started.
Only tests/test_basic.py and the external oracle are selected; this is not a complete Flask security assessment.
